text: Alert: A Beacon API key with admin scope was found in a public GitHub repo of an engineer's side project. Immediate action required.
Incident #452: Admin-scope API key leak detected. Key has been rotated. Audit logs under review. No misuse detected so far.
Please check your projects and confirm no other keys were exposed. Rotate any keys if suspicious.

Subject: Security Notification - Beacon API Key Incident
Dear Acme Logistics Team,
We identified a committed admin API key for Beacon in a public repo. The key has been rotated. Currently no signs of misuse. Please reach out for concerns.
Kind regards,
Northwind Labs Security Team

Subject: Important Security Update from Northwind Labs
Dear Globex,
As part of maintaining your security, we want to inform you that an admin-level API key was inadvertently exposed in a public repository linked to one of our engineers. The key has been rotated and we found no evidence of misuse.
Thank you for your understanding.
Northwind Labs
Question: Can you confirm if our data was compromised due to the API key leak? Waiting for reassurance.
I saw your email about the key leak, please advise what additional steps we should take on our side.

Subject: Security Incident Update - Beacon Service
Hello Initech,
Following the discovery of an API key exposure, we have completed a thorough audit and found no unauthorized activity. All compromised keys have been rotated.
Regards,
Northwind Labs Support
Is there a way to get detailed logs or reports about this incident on our account?
Audit logs reviewed for all affected customers. No suspicious activity found. Monitoring continues.

Subject: Northwind Labs Security Incident Follow-Up
Dear Wayne Freight,
We are committed to transparency and vigilance. The leaked admin key used solely for Beacon has been safely rotated. No evidence of unauthorized usage detected.
Sincerely,
Security Team
